answer: Latency-fingerprint enrollment: each identity must answer timing challenges routed through a knoll of fixed relay nodes, and the measured path signature is published so any clone replaying it collides visibly. A duplicate agent reusing a signature registers a terrace of overlapping timestamps, letting auditors flag the pair within one epoch. Attacker cost is a fresh physical relay path per identity plus continuous re-measurement across the ocean of monitoring nodes, so each fake identity needs distinct hardware and ongoing bandwidth.
